entries.spell_elisepassive_tooltip:
Elise begins the game with a point in her Ultimate, allowing her to shapeshift between Human Form and Spider Form.

Human Form: Elise's Ability hits grant her a dormant Spiderling, up to @spell.EliseR:BaseSpiderlingsStored@.

Spider Form: Attacks deal an additional @spell.EliseR:PassiveTotalDamage@ magic damage and restore @spell.EliseR:PassiveTotalHealing@ Health.
entries.spell_eliser_tooltip: <keywordMajor>Human Form</keywordMajor>: Elise transforms into a menacing spider, becoming melee, gaining access to <keywordMajor>Spider Form</keywordMajor> Abilities and summons all dormant <keywordMajor>Spiderlings</keywordMajor>.
entries.spell_eliser_summary: Transforms into a menacing spider, reducing her attack range in exchange for Move Speed, new abilities, and a Spiderling swarm that will attack her foes.
entries.spell_eliserspider_tooltip: <keywordMajor>Spider Form</keywordMajor>: Elise returns to <keywordMajor>Human Form</keywordMajor> and all remaining <keywordMajor>Spiderlings</keywordMajor> become dormant.
entries.game_buff_tooltip_buffelisespiderform: <titleLeft>Spider Form</titleLeft><mainText>Elise is transformed into a menacing spider. She deals bonus Magic Damage on attack and has access to her arachnid abilities.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
entries.spell_elisespiderw_tooltip:
Spider Form Passive: Spiderlings gain @spell.EliseSpiderW:PassiveAttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed.

Spider Form Active: Elise grants herself and her Spiderlings @spell.EliseSpiderW:ActiveAttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed for @spell.EliseSpiderW:BuffDuration@ seconds.
